pullRequests.title: Fix Chrome lifetime identity and preserve unresolved dispatch locks
pullRequests.body:
A real foreground Chrome process can lack LaunchServices `launchDate`, preventing target capture. Chrome transport, permissions, activity observation and host foreground checks now share verified kernel process birth identity. Delayed metadata cannot change that session; original legacy operations retain exact read-only observation without inferred dates or identity rewriting.

Cross-layer review additionally found that new session spelling could evade an old UNKNOWN conflict key. A conservative same-PID/tab mixed-format Core conflict relation now preserves unresolved locks while retaining existing independently recognized business-draft separation. No stored target is rewritten, no UNKNOWN is retried, and receipt equality stays exact. Initial G1/H1 approval was withdrawn before merge and superseded by the complete G2 reviews.

Standard merge completed as main `307335f6f1511fc49d57275ab19cf9c55496ba5a`, ordered parents `[60eaaef64848fc5535580e4fcb65e45f3f41e814, 5c552fc252a1e79b8370d0ce4d1b43700dcc2151]`, tree `145562bc8d01237b6be3206d1e4244810b4eb880`.
Reviewed G2: `b67c0abc00c17ce4be134ff032dcd0a6e097d109`, tree `cafe9d3d2eb58972d7e0f1d95aaa5751e27d255f`; H2 changes only the admission JSON. Two non-author exact-source reviews plus admission and CI review passed. These are engineering reviews, not a fabricated GitHub human approval.

Validation:
- Actual PR merge `47df322984d0fd326ad44a34f997c24e99916bd8`: Native 41213784658 and Feedback 41213784659 succeeded.
- Actual main push: Native 41214945466 and Feedback 41214945392 succeeded, all five required jobs; source checks verified push before/after, ordered parents, exact tree and checkout.
- ARM64 and Intel each recorded 851 XCTest executions, including all seven new session-migration regressions. The standalone baseline failed before correction and passed after; it is not relabeled XCTest.
- Final original ARM64/Intel packages bind both source and checkout to `307335f6`; ZIP, executable, resources and strict codesign checks passed. ARM package also passed a local no-window first-use self-check and reported all ordinary upload flags closed.
- Built-in screenshot probe: region passed in CI; window/fullScreen remained NOT_RUN due to foreign-overlap veto. Cloud software tests are not physical or real ChatGPT acceptance.

Final device scope: one newly authorized dedicated-chat navigation was attempted in one owned window after foreground resources became idle. It returned to Home despite valid foreground/focus/editor conditions; the redirect cause is not established. No candidate App launch, screenshot click, input, or message send occurred. Corrected-App cold click and selection retention remain BLOCKED/NOT_RUN; historical failures are not cleared. Physical pointer acceptance remains NOT_RUN.

Preservation: all candidate tables unchanged (18 assets, 7 operations, 3 upload starts), 36 protected media/journal hashes unchanged, retained new screenshot still unconsumed. Production input/start/completio

pullRequests.title: Implement Quiet Edge R2 native configuration, paging and safe interaction
pullRequests.body:
Implements Quiet Edge R2 on formal product 2bddb61a: persisted 0–90% occlusion, 0–256pt inset, 1–10 visible slots, six positions and independent display intent. Collection remains unlimited; legacy scalars/absolute placement survive until explicit choice.

Vertical group navigation retains click-time UUID/revision and does not auto-page on new captures. Guarded timer-driven refill preserves held input and double-click boundaries. Camera controls stay separate from queue/slit and avoid native input islands. Full hover preview and verified original Fit/100%/200% viewing remain distinct. Includes correct left-side magnet mask, first-empty-queue camera anchor and stable original-preview layout.

Tested source: **057a0071791d654ecfe2b7840cf86904dd600df8**. Evidence-only handoff: **4c92f6e639538bc7f3b1e06cf71fb07086add278**; source/tests/workflows unchanged, so no redundant CI rerun.

pullRequests.title: website: 精修 V2 排版、连续动效与中英文响应式体验
pullRequests.body:
## 为什么要改

用户要求官网更精致、灵动，接近 Craft 的完成度。当前已认可 V2 的气质成立，但主标题的产品指向偏弱，截图动作缺少连续性，窄屏英文排版和三张微图的空间仍需校准。

## 这版改变了什么

- 首屏改为「截图之后，思路继续。」；副文案直接说明系统截图、边缘微图与当前 ChatGPT 草稿的关系。
- 沿用青绿 split-R、中文宋体、冷暖配色和原有玻璃静物，重新整理活动样式，打磨文字比例、留白、纸片/桌面/草稿的材质与阴影。
- 新增灵感、排错、阅读场景入口；截图从来源画面连续缩入边缘，再由点击进入草稿。队列改为最早截图在上。
- 动画可取消；切换语言、窗口尺寸或离开页面时清理残余节点、恢复未确认截图，保留用户输入和原有笔记。
- 修正窄屏英文标题、第三张截图被裁切和若干浅色小字问题；保留减少动态效果支持。
- 网站仍明确内部测试、暂无公开下载；演示不读取屏幕、不上传、不发送。

## 审阅

![本轮改稿首屏](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/design/craft-refinement-20261030/website/review-refined-20261030/desktop.jpg)

完整范围与验证记录：[`website/REFINEMENT_2026-10-30.md`](website/REFINEMENT_2026-10-30.md)。

- JavaScript 语法、本地资源、HTML ID/锚点/ARIA、SVG 和 manifest 检查通过。
- 桌面及 390/768 响应式文档、中英文标题已检查。
- 完整收录/附加、动画中换语言、草稿保留、空队列、重播、细节状态、FAQ 和发布弹窗已核验。
- 最终桌面检查：图片和字体加载完整，无横向溢出。
- 未把网页演示当作真实 Mac、Safari、VoiceOver 或 ChatGPT 上传验收。

## 范围与状态

基于 main `ea22efe`。这是独立设计审阅候选；遵守此前「正式采用与上线由用户决定」的要求，保持 Draft。没有修改原生 App、CNAME、DNS 或部署配置，没有公开发布此候选。

目录：`design/website-refinement-20261030/`

- `A.html`：现有桌面场景精修，保留产品解释，改进点击目标、文字层级、响应式及后续章节。
- `B.html`：同一品牌下的放大空间边缘构图，明确标注为放大示意，不伪装原生尺寸。
- `baseline/`：原站六份源文件按 Git blob 保持一致，供当前 main 的真实对照；不是拿早期艺术稿冒充原版。
- `source/`：共用 CSS、纯本地合成状态模型与交互控制器。只有显式合成开始事件才吞噬；ready、失败、unknown、no-start 分开。草稿、原附件、用户移除意图保留，不自动重传或发送。
- `tests/`：模型测试、浏览器回归、单文件导出与像素一致性脚本。
- `docs/`：视觉取舍及 QA 摘要。
- `previews/compare-desktop-thumb.webp`：同环境截图的构图缩略比较。原尺寸桌面/手机/全页 PNG、完整测试记录、单文件 A/B 和可切换的离线评审页随本次对话 ZIP 交付；不把缩略图称为细节验收证据。

下载目录后在浏览器打开 `A.html` / `B.html`。GitHub 文件页是源码，不是已部署网站。`tests/export-portable.py` 可从提交源码生成独立 HTML。

## 已执行验证

- 模型 15/15。
- A 与 B 各 38/38 浏览器检查，共 76 项；覆盖 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 宽度、中英文及核心行为。
- 模块化与单文件版在 1440/390 的四组截图逐像素一致。
- 常规动态下两版均观察到先开始、再快速离场、稍后完成。
- 离线评审壳已实际切换原站/A/B、操作两版附件并确认 390px 宽度，无 JS 错误。

环境：Linux Chromium 144.0.7559.96，DPR1。环境禁止本地 URL 导航，使用隔离 page.set_content、资源内联和网络阻断，未改浏览器策略。不是线上 CDN、Safari、iPhone、真实 Mac、VoiceOver、生产 ChatGPT 或用户偏好测试。两次全套调用因执行时限中断，随后按 A/B 分开完整执行；不声称首次全量通过。

## 创意裁决

A 推荐作为精修主线；B 视觉表达更突出，但失去部分桌面尺度直觉，不预设整体更好。A 的提升主要在叙事、交互准确性和细节，不能宣称审美跨级或已达世界级。没有明显胜出的新 Logo，因此本轮原 Logo 完全不动。两套均为可运行候选，正式采用仍待用户判断。

唯一源提交：`f4f989bf7a828cd18eae0ee1734c7e24b15b838b`。仅新增独立设计目录。没有修改 main 根网站文件、正式 App、PR #1/#15/#19、DNS、Pages 或 Cloudflare；未上线、未创建公开发行、没有字体文件或私人截图。

## 目的与准确范围

现有 Apple Events reader 在回包到达主机前已经删除 nonce 回执；若该回包丢失，单次命令已执行却不能恢复读取。App 待提交队列还会把 timer 的启动延迟加到原选择期限上。本专项修复这两处可证明的可靠性缺口，并加固无编辑器焦点时的草稿保留回归。

这是供唯一正式集成负责人复核的范围受限技术差异。目标基线为 PR #15 的 `73251d034c8da8f486d09083b048a35cdee39bc0`，本 PR 保持 Draft；PR #15、PR #1、main 未被写入。

## 可单独合入的产品提交

- **产品/测试提交 P：`683aefb46b7ed774674a3dd2e6199868952b7b46`**，唯一父为 7325，准确 7 文件：3 个生产文件、4 个测试文件。
- 完整独立审核 source S：`6d9649c46a2f6655fd5b91afe6c306a075a2f5b2`；tree `8467441078096d7da972170750c49c508e2997b2`。

- P 后的两个提交只负责本技术分支的精确来源检查与 CI，不需要作为产品功能合入正式 PR #15。

### 实现

1. **回执只读恢复。** MAIN 仍只提交一次。读相同 PID/window/tab/nonce 的回执不再提前删除，沿用原 10 秒清理；仅空回执或 `errAETimeout (-1712)` 可有限重读。错误 nonce/schema、页面拒绝、权限/目标错误立即失败。原 1 秒接受预算未延长，每次 receipt-only AE 最多 250ms，剩余不足 50ms 不发送；收到/解码后再检查绝对期限。原 submit/identity 读取时限不变，未宣称 OS 硬实时返回。
2. **原选择绝对到期。** Entry 保存原 deadline，timer 真正启动后重算，drain 提交前复核。过期 B 只取消一次，有效 C 继续；FIFO、16 项容量、30 秒上限、原 token/ACK/目标保持。
3. **无光标保留回归。** Home/thread × body/sidebar 四案检查一次 input、正文/非折叠选区/焦点/旧附件对象属性保持，无 Send。只证明受控 VM 中页面程序自身行为，未执行真实 ChatGPT React handler。

- Queue 与 receipt 的六个精确对象：非作者 experience 审查 PASS；页面测试：非作者 magnetic 审查并实际执行 90/90 PASS。

pullRequests.title: docs: adopt fast upload-start swallow and ephemeral Riftlet queue
pullRequests.body:
## 新用户产品决策（2026-10-27）

点击当前正在使用的 ChatGPT 草稿；**实际上传开始有正向证据后，立刻以极快动效吞噬并从可见裂缝消失**，不等到最终 READY。仅明确或极高可信实际失败才会重生；UNKNOWN 在本地内部保持待核实、不占据可见队列、不自动重传。零截图零裂缝；长久未使用自动归档；支持单张和批量从可见队列移除。

## 变更

- 新增 `docs/INTERACTION_CONTRACT_2026-10-27.md`，分别定义视觉队列、后台上传完成事实、失败证据与安全重试。
- 更新 `docs/PRODUCT.md`、`docs/DECISIONS.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`README.md`、`docs/DESIGN_BRIEF.md`。
- 在 `docs/ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md`、`docs/ENGINEERING_PLAN.md`、`docs/EXECUTION_BOARD.md`、`docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` 标注被替代的旧视觉语义与待实现/待验证事项。

## 工程纪律

**纯文档决策记录；不改 Swift/JS、CI、生产配置，不启用截图真实上传，不宣称新的产品端到端测试通过。**

现有 `verifiedReady` 与 safe-retry 仍作为独立后端证据门槛，不能因动效已吞噬而写成功；`uploadStarted` 需真实可审查的提前信号，不能由普通点击/占位图冒充。原操作 `UNKNOWN` 仍只读核对。需由现有集成负责人补模型/UI/适配器/失败复活及验收，不覆盖进行中的 W2/N1/M1。

**目标分支为工程 Draft PR #1 的集成分支，不是 main。**
## 2026-10-27 追加用户裁决 P23–P28

- 在不牺牲体验与稳定性的前提下提升连续点击速度，**不要求强制并行上传**。
- **不弹上传成功提示**，用户直接查看 ChatGPT 当前草稿中的附件，自己决定何时发送。
- **一旦判为上传失败，截图必须重生为普通、可再次点击的截图**，生命周期包含点击/移除/自动归档。重点是提高失败判定精度，不能制造不可点击失败卡片；未知仍不能冒充失败。
- 当前没有可用发言框或附件输入能力时，点击**不吞噬、不消失、不转投其他窗口**。
- 成功进入草稿并吞噬后，非上传失败不自动重生；需要截图可从 macOS 原截图或 Riftlet 内部历史取回。
- 单张/批量清空只改变 Riftlet 的可见性，**不移除 ChatGPT 草稿附件**。
- **按住拖动仅为待评估方向**，不是已经确定的 V1 功能。

以上规则已同步到产品、交互、设计、开发者指令与工程验收文档。纯文档变更；未改原生 Swift/JS、未启用生产上传或更改当前 Draft PR #1 / main。

## 2026-10-27 第二轮体验要求（用户确认 P29–P33）

- **当前 ChatGPT 草稿具有有效发言框/附件入口时，即使未将光标放入发言框，用户点击 Riftlet 微图也应直接完成附加**；只绑定真正的点击时当前目标，不改写文字/选区。Web 与 Mac 各自研究/验收。
- **系统截图不要拍入 Riftlet 自己的缩略图**属于重点技术可行性专项：必须区分 ScreenCaptureKit 客户端过滤与 Apple 系统 Screenshot.app 行为；考虑可靠性/权限/竞态与失败退路，不预先保证百分之百排除。
- 无有效发言框/权限时不吞噬，提供极轻的按下→回退及按需原因；正常成功仍不弹出提示。
- 正在 hover/按下/点击/队列动效/交互中的图不因闲置时钟到期突然归档，睡眠唤醒时也要保护操作。
- 用户同意轻量公开发行基础体验：首次安装权限、支持矩阵、独立暂停与隐藏、内部历史、格式/画质、存储安全、原生布局/无障碍、文字反馈与隐私诊断、更新与回退、少量真实用户测试。**明确排除首版功能膨胀**。

新增：
- `docs/RELEASE_UX_REQUIREMENTS_2026-10-27.md` — 用户批准的发行体验/分阶段验收契约；
- `docs/PRO_FEASIBILITY_REVIEW_BRIEF_2026-10-27.md` — 给 Pro 的 A 未聚焦发言框附加、B 系统截图排除 Riftlet 专项研究指令；研究范围而非开发授权。

**交付范围维持纯文档。** 工程并未新增实测 PASS；W2/N1/M1、Draft PR #1 和 main 未由本 PR 改动。待 Pro 研究/真机证据后由既有工程负责人裁决最小实现。

## Pro 技术可行性报告回收与裁决（2026-10-27）

已读取用户提交的 Pro 研究文字稿，并核对正式 HEAD、Apple/Chromium 公开 API 文档。**报告另称有 13 页 PDF，但 PDF 本体未在本轮工具会话中挂载；没有声称归档或逐页审查 PDF。**

[独立研究结论与工程最小交接](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/docs/fast-swallow-product-contract-20261027/docs/PRO_FEASIBILITY_REVIEW_FINDINGS_2026-10-27.md)：

- Web 发言框**未聚焦但可用**时附加，已有文件输入路径可复用，首版 P0。当前真正缺口是冷首击完整目标 ACK 时序、正文交互后授权空档、空页面代安全回收、可用 composer 检查；真实物理一击仍未验证。
- Mac AX/粘贴另行按客户端证据准入，不盲去掉焦点保护，也不拖住 Web。
- 系统 Screenshot.app 无受支持的全入口排除窗口保证；先实施不会被新图/重排/唤醒意外解除的独立隐藏，再隔离来源实测；不偷换用户原系统截图方式。
- 现有 UI 的无效点击短反馈、交互期间不自动归档可复用；需覆盖 mouseUp→prepare 异步窗口。

**纯文档研究交接。** 未改变主工程 PR #1、main、App 代码、生产配置，也未产生新的 Mac PASS。可由现有负责人按研究中列出的最小验收包与已经进行的 W2/N1/M1 接续，避免重做全面技术架构。

issues.title: 截图入缝动效正式裁决：仅「无」与「磁力吸引」（设计已交付，待原生集成）
issues.body:
# 最终产品裁决（2026-10-28）：仅保留「无」和「磁力吸引」

此前六/九模式探索已经由用户亲自比较。**正式截图入缝设置只允许两个选项：无、磁力吸引。** 其它效果（直接入缝、时空缩影、量子隧穿、引力牵引、切面折跃、晶格重构、粒子湮灭、裂缝吞噬及此前名称/变体）全部退出正式候选；历史设计素材不删除、不伪称获批。

**尚未决定正式 App 默认选择哪一项。** 原型首次打开采用「无」只是安全的展示起始状态，不是产品默认款授权。

## 已归档可评审的独立交付

- **[Draft PR #10：两模式动效与实施规格](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/pull/10)**
- 设计分支：`design/arrival-none-magnet-20261028`
- [可离线交互原型](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/design/arrival-none-magnet-20261028/design/arrival-motion/two-modes/Riftlet-Arrival-Two-Modes.html)
- [运动参数、降级策略与 AppKit 接入规格](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/design/arrival-none-magnet-20261028/design/arrival-motion/two-modes/README.md)

## A. 无（none）

- 收录后**立即呈现**最终尺寸与队列位置。
- 截图入场、点击压入位移、吞噬位移、补位滑动、失败重生装饰动画全部为 0ms。
- 仍然保留真实点击身份、正常 UI、上传事实判断、错误恢复与 UNKNOWN 安全行为，不牺牲功能语义。

## B. 磁力吸引（magnet）

唯一保留的动态表现：**截图形成清晰小图 → 朝裂缝方向轻微颤动蓄力 → 非线性加速向裂缝 → 穿过固定遮挡直边并显现。** 不用粒子、闪光、弹簧回摆或巨大虚影，适合每日高频重复。

供原生真机测试的候选值（不是上传等待时间）：

| 阶段 | 时间 | 表达 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 缩小 | 0–123 ms | 源图副本先限制在 240×150pt 内，再缩至不超过 58×46pt 的等比小图 |
| 蓄力 | 123–224 ms | 沿目标方向最多约 1.85pt 的轻颤；有衰减包络，不形成持续闪烁 |
| 加速吸入 | 224–484 ms | 进度 `t^2.25`，移动速度从慢到快，向边界与队列目标的共同轴收束 |
| 接触与落位 | 484–560 ms | 目标端从同一条笔直边缘后连续出现并减速定住 |

保留原工程约 72×56pt 的图像包络、25% 遮挡、0.7pt 笔直边界和固定行距；参数需在真实 DPI、距离和用户频率下再次审美审查。

## 交互与降级不可突破

1. assetReady 时队列**立即可点**，无需等 560ms 演出结束；pointerDown/取消/隐藏时终止装饰性源副本，仍由同一 assetID 控制业务行为。
2. 只有证据支持的 `uploadStarted` 才能视觉吞噬，**明确失败**恢复同一正常可点击资产，UNKNOWN 安全保留在历史中，不盲目重试。绝不删除原始截图或自动发送消息。
3. 连续截图只允许一张源端装饰正在运行；新截图令前一张在队列中落定，不叠加飞行残影，不丢资产。
4. 源矩形缺失/不可信、跨显示器不安全、系统 Reduce Motion、浮层失败时即时降级为 **无**，不阻塞截图导入，不引入第三模式。源矩形可以研究文件扩展属性 `com.apple.metadata:kMDItemScreenCaptureGlobalRect`，但须实测而不能保证所有截图类型或 macOS 版本可用。
5. 保持原 macOS 快捷键。系统浮动缩略图相关设置仅在明确用户同意下引导/配置与恢复；该设计工作未修改系统设置。

## 当前状态 / 验收边界

**设计原型与实施规格已写入 Draft PR #10，但未进入正式 App。** 原生 AppKit 接入、源矩形与跨屏转换、overlay 透明区域穿透、真实 Mac 性能、物理连续点击和实际 ChatGPT 附件接入仍需要独立工程验证。PR #1、main、收录器、上传适配器和现有真机工作树不受本设计提交影响。

该 Issue 保持 Open 直到完成受控集成与真机验收。

planDocument.content:
# R2.1 final integration, UI freeze and device acceptance

## Authorized scope and source

The user authorized the final Quiet Edge R2.1 integration into the actual current
main on 2026-10-31, followed by a freeze of this phase's functional visual work.
This supersedes the earlier mainline-migration exclusion of PR #24. The existing
source-admission protocol and every product safety boundary continue unchanged.

- Main integration base: `749f3ae81b8a75a9462506bfeb3d3cf2796ed154`.
- Independently delivered implementation: `1e834902794048942f112aee98bc5fcec5566930`.
- Original PR #24 handoff: `c63309c3850fd16969dc0117d47da5bc854e9cc8`.
- Original formal product ancestor: `253ac8db92bfba9083d485b71b84c594223da217`.

The final source checkpoint and its direct admission-only child are identified
by `engineering/mainline/source-admission.json`. The formal integration PR records
actual PR/main CI, original artifact IDs, source/checkout identities and hashes.
Use those completed results and the App's `build-info.json`; this source document
does not pre-approve a pending run or infer a physical result from compilation.

The integration selects the four R2.1 UI implementation files, two synthetic
native-helper files, six UI test files, six fixed synthetic PNGs with their
manifest/README, and the R2.1 capture script. The existing Native workflow gains
the same seven-line capture step; the mainline triggers, five check identities,
source gate and all existing execution steps remain intact. The R2.1 source and
handoff history are preserved as the initial integration commit's second parent, while
their archived PNG/MOV evidence is not duplicated into the current main tree.

No old R2 baseline replaces main. App composition and instance ownership, Core,
Capture, adapters, Feedback, services, database, Package, resources, packaging,
the 34 approved website/configuration objects, and all accepted historical
evidence remain at their main objects. Only the explicitly reviewed increment
is admitted. The complete object map is in this integration's provenance record.

## Product decisions that are now fixed

R2.1 retains R2 placement, vertical pagination, original image Fit, original
input islands and strict upload-start ownership. Three free-edge contours and
the neutral number surface meet a fixed seam plane. Decorative padding and
shadows do not enlarge mouse-receiving regions; press feedback is stationary.
The magnetic trajectory retains its original owner/lifetime and clips the full
decorated surface. No new user preference or appearance mode is introduced.

Continuous preview uses 450 ms cold and 90 ms warm dwell, a frozen current-page
canvas, atomic image/UUID/rank presentation, session/request/revision fences,
one active decode and one replaceable pending request. New screenshots outside
the visible page preserve a valid preview; actual page/identity/geometry changes
and foreground-application changes revoke it. The original number hit frame is
preserved even where it is smaller than the design document's assumed minimum.

After this integration's successful standard merge, this phase's functional UI
is frozen. Do not add another layout, microimage style or long-lived design
candidate. Concentrate work on real usability, reliability and first-release
readiness. A blocking defect demonstrated by final acceptance may receive a
minimal reviewed fix on a short-lived PR from actual main, with targeted
reverification and the existing full formal gates. New explicit user direction
can supersede the freeze; an agent must not infer that authorization from a
minor stylistic difference or an old design exploration.

## Exact evidence boundaries

The original PR #24 Native run `41183924489` and Feedback run `41183924475`
tested implementation `1e834902...` on checkout `e3dee8ae...`. Their execution
jobs passed, but both overall workflows failed because the old exact formal
source gate was deliberately not repinned. These results are prior increment
evidence, not a fully admitted combined build and not the final main runs.
The first R2.1 native failure and its reviewed correction remain in their
original history. Do not conceal them or bypass the new mainline gate.

Original R2.1 WindowServer PNGs and sampled motion cover synthetic owned native
windows at 1x. They support the documented appearance and sampled lifecycle
observations. Static preview does not prove a real-pointer A-to-B-to-A sequence;
variable-cadence motion does not prove every frame or a latency benchmark.
Final combined CI, native image review and package checks are recorded against
their actual new source/checkout. Physical input, actual 2x/mixed monitors and
real ordinary-App upload require their own evidence.

Formal integration added a native CALayer regression for visual refresh during
an already committed composite exit. Provisional source `0134dddb...` reproduced
the defect on ARM: assigning the moving layer's frame restored its effective
position and exposed content again, even though the transform and named
animation remained. The minimal repair assigns untransformed bounds/base position
instead, preserving the existing exit transform and animation. The regression
checks both sides, narrow/wide slices, every moving surface, the fixed mask and
contact plane, source dimensions and animation values/duration. Its initial
test-only overload compilation error at `fd2a0046...` and the subsequent actual
native failure remain separately recorded in the integration provenance. Final
corrected-source CI must pass; these earlier failures are not admission results.

The old U1 approximately 1.876638-second observation is internal-configuration
swallow start followed by later independent background success. It retains its
prebound, focused, existing-chat scope. It is not default production acceptance
or a 1.88-second completed upload. The prior selection-preservation failure is
still unresolved until the exact final App proves the required behavior.

## Production and data boundaries

Ordinary production input/start/completion, built-in screenshot upload,
safe-retry and Web continuation remain closed. Existing restricted-candidate
scope is unchanged. Keep old UNKNOWN operations, original screenshots, media,
history, databases and feedback identities. Do not delete, reset, unlock or
replay them to make acceptance pass. Do not expand a default production profile
to obtain a test result. No public release or founder Beta trial is requested.

Source admission records real non-author engineering review; it does not prove
a separate GitHub human APPROVED identity. Main protection proceeds separately
only with actual Administration permission, a supported configuration/readback
surface and an eligible non-author reviewer. Apply the approved request only
when it will not lock the repository. Otherwise record the exact missing
capability and continue unrelated integration. Never bypass a remote rule.

## Minimal final Codex device acceptance

Use the completed final main build and the matching architecture's original CI
ZIP. Record main/source/checkout/tree, run/artifact IDs, ZIP/binary hashes, macOS,
architecture and signing status. Read existing instances, data roots and queued
Feedback obligations before using a new isolated test operation. Do not overwrite
another developer's tree or use the helper/demo as the ordinary product App.

1. **Startup, ownership and recovery.** Start the ordinary unified App; verify
   screenshot/history/settings/Feedback belong to the same package/process.
   Check second-instance rejection, normal quit/restart and isolated controlled
   abnormal recovery. Preserve stores and old operations; do not delete locks.
2. **R2.1 microimages and interaction.** Verify left/right fixed contact planes,
   source orientation/proportion, alpha display, neutral numbers and stationary
   press. Check retained R2 positions/configuration, paging, protected refill,
   new arrivals outside the current page, and continuous A-to-B-to-A pointer
   preview with cold/warm dwell and no stale image/identity or canvas movement.
   Check original-image Fit/100%/200%, missing/replaced originals and magnetic
   arrival/strict-start exit. Preserve the existing click targets and draft focus.
3. **System capture and cancellation.** On final source check region, window,
   full screen and cancel, original-byte import/deduplication, normal screenshot
   exclusion and source/target binding. A foreign-overlap safety veto remains
   NOT_RUN for the affected functional case, not a fabricated capture PASS.
4. **Actual one-click attachment and repeat use.** Along the existing approved
   isolated path, use new screenshots/operations for existing chat and Home/local,
   focused/unfocused editor, natural cold first click without a pre-existing ACK,
   and consecutive uploads. Record unique input, true uploadStarted, swallow
   start, later independent completion and restart state separately. Safe zero-
   input refusal is a safety result, not successful one-click usability.
5. **Preservation and the known selection failure.** Preserve body, stable old
   attachments and noncollapsed selection. Locate first blur/collapse and compare
   the native attachment path; do not force focus, restore a stale Range or edit
   body text to manufacture success. Keep UNKNOWN and original media unchanged.
6. **Native Feedback to cloud.** First establish independent access to the same
   deployment's D1 and correct private Issues repository, plus exact cleanup.
   Then use one new synthetic native feedback and correlate original UUID/body,
   durable receipt and one private Issue; check real IME, draft/restart, offline
   recovery/idempotency, frozen diagnostics, deletion and screenshot isolation.
   Follow `engineering/evidence/2026-10-29-feedback-cloud/CODEX_REAL_MAC_E2E.md`;
   old cloud script or offline demo success does not replace this native path.
7. **Physical environment and permissions.** Check actual multi-monitor
   disconnect/reconnect, negative coordinates, 2x/mixed Retina, Spaces/full screen,
   VoiceOver spoken output and physical mouse/keyboard. If one case requires a
   person or a new OS permission, record its precise requirement and continue
   the other cases. Do not automate consent or claim physical evidence from
   model geometry, synthetic callbacks or CI screenshots.

Return MAC_PASS/CLOUD_PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED per case, exact source and redacted
evidence, residual obligations and minimal corrective work. Inherit already
proved scope without restarting research. No unattended executor is implied by
this checklist. Production activation requires independently approved evidence
for the exact final App and the specific capability being admitted.

pullRequests.body:
## Sole-writer integration handoff

This independent branch adds only an **unapplied patch, deterministic reproducer and integration note**. It does not modify production source or the ordinary test list. Local Codex remains the sole Free integrator; consume the patch at a natural checkpoint after comparing local WIP.

### Concrete defect and bounded fix
When `HOST_DOCUMENT_RENEW` succeeds and worker memory loses the document handshake before `HOST_REFRESH`, the binding service can return exactly `{ok:false,reason:'invalid-host-document'}`. Renewal currently latches that transport loss as a scope denial, preventing the already-existing one-shot fresh handshake.

The patch classifies only this exact record as `invalid-host-binding`, like the existing failed-renew/focus paths. It does not directly rebind, clear a prior denial, grant an old scope, add retry opportunities, or extend the original six-second deadline. Unknown/denied/different scopes and malformed replies still latch denial.

**This is a deterministic lifecycle defect, not an established root cause of CI39101646460's J2 failure.** That original run has a pre-diagnostic startup observation gap; no CI/browser rerun was done here.

### Exact candidate and evidence
- Reviewed source: `206af45931e417106c3c236ceb881c43e31d1c09`.
- Rechecked current Free base: `c070abb567f97e1937fbd200860754b8afcc905c`; intervening docs/J2-diagnostic changes leave this owner unchanged.
- Original owner SHA256: `25325cab877fad024d513049bcdc8ce056055703499c9282bc0d3caa68164e70`.
- Patched owner SHA256: `57f648a96468c36eefadd9f5e63285cf21c88427c65630d7f5868e01ab1fe31f`.
- Patch SHA256: `8ef8e98adb33972a16e0a6d828137e9c013acd11b50cdfd9ce412bec7cf3836b`.
- Reproducer SHA256: `2d9fcd05260a6fddf340af8d3cba2c2b678a9917a47eed5849a38537662df90f`.

Before applying: **2 RED / 8 passing controls**. After applying to actual source in an isolated tree: **10/10 new + 92/92 existing affected tests, zero skips**. Independent parent review also ran the actual patched new tests: **10/10, CLEAN**.

Controls cover exact malformed/scope refusals, previous denial retained, stop/pagehide cancellation, failed replacement consuming the original attempt, original six-second timeout and late response. All data are synthetic.

### Consume
```sh
# Intentionally reproduces two failures on unchanged production source:
node --test tests/host/renew-handshake-recovery.repro.mjs

# Sole integrator only, after inspecting current local source/WIP:
git apply --check tests/host/renew-handshake-recovery.patch
git apply tests/host/renew-handshake-recovery.patch
node --test tests/host/renew-handshake-recovery.test.mjs
```

Do not treat merely merging/cherry-picking this handoff as applying the product fix. The patch contains the one-line owner change and its ordinary regression test. No real account, native body, Free/main write, scale qualification or release assertion is included.

## 问题与范围

新 worker 完全丢失有效 context evidence 时，URL、DOM、标题、roster、旧缓存或扩展自行 GET 无法证明用户当前选择。直接猜 context 会破坏原 C1/C2/C3 边界。

本 PR 只处理 **B：没有有效上下文证据**。A（证据仍有效、transport / 握手失效）继续由 dot 负责。依据 PR16 的 [VAIWL_PRO_SCOPE_CLAIM](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/pull/16#issuecomment-6239935729) 和最新用户专项授权，正式 Free 的整合写入者仍为 dot。

- 初始声明基准：`3c8a33dae36ca0de11841570ac6fb44d4331dd5a`
- 交付状态：**Draft / 可独立审查 / Free 尚未接线整合 / G BLOCKED**

## 本 PR 实现

新增内部策略 `createNoReceiptContextRecovery`，复用现有 BrowserFrameContext、ScopeResolution、BrowserRequestContext 和 ScopeAuthority，不签发 receipt、grant 或 scope。

缺证据立即返回 `ambiguous/current-context-unproven`，等待没有网络、轮询或挂起工作。既有原生请求 owner 接受新证据后，才进入原授权闭包；保留原 receipt 身份、selection epoch、TTL 和 HOST_REFRESH 剩余六秒。B 失败不能靠同一 receipt 自动重试，连续重启不重放旧证据。

同一私有 producer 的并发等待者共享一次工作并独立取消；外部 pending 不转移授权或清理权。原 Authority 返回及 subscriber 交付前均重新检查，新 context / 撤权 / 到期 / stop / 晚回复不能恢复旧上下文。

[规格与调用合同](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/462ff1b2fb7b7fe4103b1b63f4e5f13e4babb013/docs/specs/chatgpt-host/CONTEXT_RECOVERY_NO_RECEIPT.md) 包含有限状态机、输入输出、新鲜度、不可实现反例、取消与清理、预算关系，以及第 7 节的**精确接线 diff**。该 diff 只涉及既有 `src/runtime/host-binding-service.mjs`，由 dot 应用；本 PR 没有修改此文件或其他既有生产文件。

## 实际验证

所有下列结果均来自本次实际候选，未使用历史 Free 全量结果替代；最终每组均 0 fail / 0 cancelled / 0 skipped。

|---|---|
| 新专项：53 策略 + 11 实际服务集成，未接线源只在临时副本应用 diff | **64 / 64 PASS** |
| 同一专项在已完整接线的临时源上执行 | **64 / 64 PASS**，同一批用例，不累加为 128 |

```sh
node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-reporter=spec tests/runtime/context-recovery/*.test.mjs
```

集成测试实际运行原 HELLO → REFRESH → MOUNT → JOIN/CONFIRM → UiGrant → VIEW 链和 repositories，覆盖旧 personal 缓存拒读、新 team 正确恢复、同 URL 切换、双 tab 隔离、连续重启、并发失效和旧回复。直接复用原 fresh-grant + VIEW oracle：无信号在原 15000 ms 失败，晚到恢复不能追记为原窗口通过。

pullRequests.title: B4: automatic MV3 rebinding and safe multi-tab manual drafts
pullRequests.body:
B4 closes the remaining MV3 lifecycle and multi-tab gaps on accepted PR #7 (`dc73231d498d244e8b7bd14dfe95ba981b977537`). A page now automatically reconnects after the real 20-second lease expires, worker cold start, visibility restoration, freeze/resume and SPA changes. Unsaved manual fields retain their original revision; remote changes preserve the draft, surface a CAS conflict, and require an explicit second save after reviewing the latest value. Bounded requests and reconnect feedback prevent a held reply from blocking recovery; command and undo writes are never automatically replayed.

Existing IndexedDB, CAS, idempotence and undo implementations are reused. Original product failures and browser-driver failures remain in the evidence directory. Changes are confined to the new B4 branch; PR #7 and main remain unchanged.

Validation on macOS 27.0, Chrome 154.0.8037.99, Node 26.8.2, Python 3.14.7 and isolated Playwright 1.63.0:

- Actual Chrome MV3: **5/5 core + 1/1 lifecycle journeys PASS** using fresh headless profiles and the extension's real IndexedDB.
- Actual worker stopped event, automatic restart without reload or driver wake probe, new boot identity and persistent manual data.
- Real background-tab visibility and trusted freeze/resume events, A/B/unknown isolation, native node ownership, 120 topics / 604 window references.
- Regression: **121/121 Node**, **17/17 real page**, **19/19 real MV3**, **49/49 DOM**. DOM uses the existing mocked regression setup and does not substitute for native acceptance.

Latest delivery: `3b1a40f9d2bedfd3180a32c3db6d12d5a28e9fd9`. Last runtime change: `9c81c6b9fc0a5f0d352f3d603595591723ec3d64`; subsequent changes adapt the lifecycle driver and preserve evidence/docs. All final native runtime/build hashes match the delivered runtime. The five core test ASTs are unchanged after their final run; the manifest records the later driver hash differences explicitly.

- 定向复验：2 PASS / 1 LIMITED。实际观测 VAIWL→PAIA 占位和反向挂载，而非只推断安装顺序。
- 真 content script/Shadow DOM/worker 握手；真实 worker 停止事件与内存哨兵丢失；扩展 origin 已提交 IDB 合成记录在重启后保留。
- 原生合成控件的节点/处理器、草稿、选区、样式、模型/工具/交互值、搜索及未知入口未被替换。
- 构建可复现性与已运行源码/证据完整性核验通过，不能据此把功能失败改为通过。

## 保留的失败与架构后果

1. 原探针漏掉静默 pushState，500ms 后仍有旧挂载。独立 route 变体采用浏览器 webNavigation 通知，两次约 14ms/25ms 撤销；只证明失效通知，不证明账户身份或新正文就绪。
2. 快速切换文档被旧 lease 占用拒绝且无重试。正式 B1 需要可信 document handoff，不能放宽 scope 检查。
3. 实际扩展禁用后 250ms 尚有旧 DOM，active timer 到期后才清除。重新启用不自动重注入旧页；不能保证瞬时/冻结条件下无残留。
4. 裸 CDP 加载的 profile 在 runtime.reload 后 disabled；正确临时开发者模式下可正常 reload，并经显式合成页刷新恢复。但旧 DOM 残留仍在。环境限制和真实残留分别记录。
5. CDP freeze 命令虽返回成功，未观测有效 trusted freeze/resume，保留 BLOCKED。

首轮误把 CDP target ID 当作 worker boot ID、公开页面分类器漏判中文等待页等，均保留原输出及可逆源码差异，未放宽原始能力断言。

## 真实宿主门槛

全新未登录 Profile 仅访问一次 ChatGPT 公开页面，HTTP 403，未进入应用，未登录、未发消息、未绕过挑战。

**真实登录 ChatGPT 功能通过数为 0。** 实际账户/组织 witness、原始用户发送时间与导出格式/覆盖、真实 Project 链接及权限、完整原生功能五格/物理 IME/真实阅读返回槽位、实际 PAIA 构建共存均未通过。本轮 PAIA 是独立占位扩展，不是 PAIA 本体。

技术路线：保留原生应用所有权 + 扩展 origin 派生仓库 + 浏览器文档/路由失效 + 严格 scope/epoch/coverage。下一具体工程建议是 B1 ScopeRepository + DocumentBindingBroker；本 PR 不自动启动正式 B/C。

## R0-04 源码准备，未加载扩展

从已验网页 fixture head `e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964` 独立分支，仅新增 19 个文件，全部在原 R0 三目录。当前 head `d5c66221f18a24145974b9696a8788a5a8b90155`；tree `e9549b9229c1f7bd237f7754913f9156712c719f`。

**本 PR stacked 在 #2 的实验分支上，保持 Draft，不改 #2 已证 fixture 或既有 workflow，不合并任何 PR，不启动正式 B/C。** 原 54 blob 已逐个核验不变。

## 可审查实现

- 仅 loopback 专用合成 A/B 页面，静态 content script + MV3 module worker。
- 精确 schema 与 browser MessageSender 字段校验；worker boot/client/request/lease 相关性；32 个内存 slot 上限。
- 请求超时、迟到响应、重连代际、主动 expiry、取消和 cleanup 异常闭锁；无持久存储、heartbeat 或 page-message bridge。
- 自有固定标记、可信生命周期事件接线、initial-hidden 拒绝；不读取/隐藏/重建 native island。
- 确定性源码组装和普通 Node/Python 测试，没有 browser/server/extension loader。

## 实际测试与独审

- **30/30 新 Node + 4/4 新 Python 静态组装测试通过**。
- **27/27 原 Node + 2/2 原 Python mock 回归通过**；10 个新 JS 语法检查通过。
- worker 入口仅在 mock Chrome runtime 中运行；content 入口仅在普通 Node VM + 假 owned slot 中运行。两者都不是真实浏览器/MV3证据。
- 独审复跑上述测试，并核验原 54 文件。发现 cleanup 同步重入会双挂载/遗留 timer 的漏洞，先新增失败回归并留 raw，再修复和独立复核。
- 首次 validator 两处失败（bare query marker/null boolean）也保留，没有放宽测试。

[源码说明](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/d5c66221f18a24145974b9696a8788a5a8b90155/experiments/r0/mv3/README.md) · [范围/能力报告](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/d5c66221f18a24145974b9696a8788a5a8b90155/docs/experiments/results/r0-mv3-preparation-2026-10-10/REPORT.md) · [独审](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/d5c66221f18a24145974b9696a8788a5a8b90155/docs/experiments/results/r0-mv3-preparation-2026-10-10/REVIEW.md) · [原始输出与hash](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/d5c66221f18a24145974b9696a8788a5a8b90155/docs/experiments/results/r0-mv3-preparation-2026-10-10/source-checks.json)

## 未执行与下一门槛

**扩展加载、真实 worker 终止/restart、reload、disable/re-enable、freeze/resume 均 NOT_RUN。** 新分支不匹配原CI push触发分支；没有修改或触发扩展 CI，也未操作日常浏览器、账号、权限、付费或其他仓库。

CHECK 未作为自动 worker-death detector；没有 pushState 生产路由观察；4秒常量只在活动 JavaScript/正常 Date.now 下有合同意义。不能据此开启敏感投影或隐藏原生导航。PD-01–PD-12不变。

下一步仅在取得明确许可后，让既有免费 runner 的临时 Chromium profile 加载自有探针并执行纯 loopback 合成生命周期矩阵。真实 ChatGPT/PAIA 是另外的环境与授权门槛。

## 目的与范围

R0_CAPABILITY_SPIKE 的隔离合成工程。固定提案 head `223a34f4b4f47d56b17b8d2c1cd3afa5a162101f` 为基线；当前实验 head `e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964`，tree `8f8281d44072a240fcf661f477ef8b1abbc6c1ae`。

**保持 stacked Draft，base 为设计提案分支，不合并、不修改 PR #1，不推进正式 B/C，也不批准 PD-01–PD-12。** main 仍为 `76e3dbdb283769e5c94fcef2de35f6b21cf7e49c`，提案原 25 文件及原 R0 实验 18 文件保持原内容。

相对提案共新增 29 文件：原 18 个 R0 文件、此次 10 个结果文件，以及用户于 2026-10-10 明确批准的唯一范围例外 `.github/workflows/r0-fixture.yml`。其他新增内容全部在 `experiments/r0/**`、`tests/r0/**`、`docs/experiments/results/**`。

## 实现与实际证据

- 合成 witness 的 scope/epoch gate，未知/切换/旧异步响应拒绝；route/document/tab/branch/render metadata 错配拒绝。
- 同 scope T0/P1-T1/P2-T2 引用聚合，原生来源不变；派生标题分离、人工 revision/lock 优先。
- 仅附加自有导航；保留原生节点身份、焦点、选区和合成草稿；不隐藏或重建原生导航、输入框或 transcript。
- 正常 JavaScript 运行期间的自动 expiry 有界调度、换绑取消、旧 callback 和 cleanup 异常回归。
- **18/18 独立浏览器断言 × 4 次真实 Chromium 执行 = 72/72 PASS**：桌面 1440×1000、窄屏 390×844，各重复两次。没有 page error、页面外部请求或横向溢出。
- **27/27 Node 契约 + 2/2 Python mocked-runner 分类测试 PASS**，另有 7 模块语法、Python 编译及 fixture build。Mock 不计作浏览器证据。
- 首次有效浏览器执行：[run 38040447893](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/actions/runs/38040447893)，测试 head `4d04a4bbf025c83435c7122065bc326fc72b09ba`。
- **报告提交后的最终精确 head 也已通过**：[run 38040853136](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/actions/runs/38040853136)，head `e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964`，全部步骤实际执行 success，72 浏览器检查、27 Node、2 mock 再次通过。
- Chromium 140.0.7339.16 / Playwright 1.55.0 / Node 22.16.0 / Python 3.12.11 / Ubuntu runner image 20261004.327.1。
- 独立审查重新获取远端完整日志、验证 4 份证据原字节数及 SHA-256、13 项源码 hash、最终解码器负向测试。未放宽断言或修改 browser runner 来换取绿色结果。

## 失败记录与恢复边界

早先本地 EPERM 和云浏览器无法访问 loopback 的记录保留。首个新 CI run 38040381950 在 workflow 校验阶段失败，零 jobs、零浏览器执行；定位为 job-level env 不支持 runner context，修复后通过。没有删除失败历史或盲目重跑。

BF-12 仍明确记录 `cleanLayout:false / nativeOperable:true`：省略 dispose 会留下 additive DOM。BF-18 只证明活动 JavaScript timer；不能证明冻结、禁用代码或 worker 终止后的独立恢复。**敏感持续投影在这些状态下仍 NO_GO；原生导航隐藏/替换仍 NO_GO。**

[最新能力矩阵与实际浏览器结果](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964/docs/experiments/results/r0-ci-2026-10-10/REPORT.md) · [独立审查](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964/docs/experiments/results/r0-ci-2026-10-10/REVIEW.md) · [原始日志证据](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964/docs/experiments/results/r0-ci-2026-10-10/evidence-log-excerpt.txt) · [保留的先前环境记录](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/e2e45a897417a5a38148f14e4cad469837a29964/docs/experiments/results/r0-2026-10-09/ENVIRONMENT_ATTEMPTS.json)

**整体 LIMITED。** GO 仅限上述合成 fixture。真实 account/Project、宿主 route/body ownership、完整导出覆盖、真实 MV3、实际 PAIA 共存仍 BLOCKED/NOT_RUN；物理 IME、screen reader、真实模型/附件/Canvas/语音/发送控件未验证。

- 实验环境：Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73，Node 24.22.1，Playwright 1.62.1，Linux，全新隔离 Profile，回环匿名宿主，阻断外网。仓库声明 Playwright 版本与此不同；真实 Mac/ChatGPT 全部相应项仍 NOT_RUN。

本次不是要求你重新选架构或重读数千份研究。先读本指令、当前 `docs/AUTHORITY.md` 顶部现行决定及被本任务修改的源码；遇具体产品规则才查对应原规格。历史证据原件完整保留。

候选对象已实际取回并核对tree，可在隔离工作树取回：

```bash
git fetch --no-tags origin 7275d88223a69f4c4675c71c20062a0fc7df59ce
git show --stat 7275d88223a69f4c4675c71c20062a0fc7df59ce
```

它没有分支ref，不能由PR HEAD推定已应用。另有同提交patch和以370512为前置的Git bundle；不得把取回对象本身当作正式集成或用户安装。

## 1. 已裁决的唯一技术路线

**保留方案 B 的原生文档流 + extension-origin iframe；采用本候选已经实现的有限布局拥有权、原生区域重新验证和分离的生命周期。** 保留正式 renderer、导航、IDB/CAS、ScopeAuthority、UiGrant、原生动作和数据来源模型。

以下方案不得重新进入默认实现：

1. 以 fixed/manual Popover 承载私人主画布，或为画布占满100vh而滚走原生输入。
2. 将任意共同祖先或 plain DIV 自动设成 display:contents，再以全部原生后代/class/style/文本/paint不变来证明安全。
3. 用扩大遮罩、隐藏整块原生 NAV、复制/移动/重建输入、重绑原生按钮事件换布局通过。
4. 把整个页面限定为仅能恢复一次 Worker，或每次 JOIN 后无条件无限重试。
5. 将布局存在、BOOT、VIEW ready、同 URL、本地 UUID 或截图当作权限/服务器账户证明。
6. 将 Chrome Side Panel 或独立扩展页作为不经产品批准的 v2.7 替代品。它们可承载现有设置、备份等辅助界面，不承担主工作空间替换。

有限的原生 seam 是版本化兼容合同，不是 ChatGPT 官方稳定 API。未知结构保持原生可用并给固定诊断，不能通过推测 selector 或吞异常宣称支持。

| 处理 | 精确范围 |
|---|---|
| 保留 | `src/data/`、现有runtime权限/IDB/CAS；正式 `navigation.mjs` / `styles.mjs` / free-frame-client；原NativeAction与三态模型 |
| 整合已完成修改 | 本候选10个生产文件及10个测试文件；使用本指令§3的语义，不另起实现 |
| 继续改有限差额 | 当前适用fixture/CI入口、F02/F08文案、现场profile的有限声明；见§5 |
| 淘汰为生产路线、保留历史 | `src/navigation/mount-surface.mjs` 的旧私人manual/fixed主承载；当前content-session已只导入createFlowMountSurface，不得重新接回。旧whole-NAV mask、双popover前置、全子树paint冻结与整页一次恢复均失效 |
| 禁止清理 | 原IDB、旧资产/草稿/Profile、批准原型、原CI/失败回执、与本次无关的工作树成果；不做“大扫除式重构” |

## 2. 先保全唯一 writer，再整合候选

1. 在正式工作树只读核查 `git status --porcelain=v2 --untracked-files=normal`、当前 HEAD、remote 分支与 PR最新提交/评论。核实正在写相同模块的执行者。无法核实则继续隔离副本，不覆盖正式树。
2. 将已有 dirty、未追踪成果及必要上下文做非破坏性保全；不可用 reset --hard、clean、强推或删除旧工作树解决冲突。不得默认 stash 可以替代用户资料备份。
3. 在干净隔离 worktree 先取回上述候选并审阅 diff。若正式 HEAD 已前进，逐模块合并语义；相同修复已存在就复用，不回退新成果。不得在原脏树盲目 cherry-pick。
4. 原 writer 完成正式整合，记录最终代码 SHA 和本候选的继承关系。无需新建长期竞争分支/PR。
5. 候选不修改数据库 schema、原始资产、权限来源或正式安装。不要把集成代码变更同时变成清库、重装或自动迁移任务。

## 3. 本轮已实现，禁止重新开发的核心修改

### 3.1 布局拥有权与原生读取

涉及：`src/host/document-flow-layout.mjs`、`src/host/chatgpt-adapter.mjs`、`src/host/chatgpt-observed-profile.mjs`、`src/host/native-flow-diagnostic.mjs`、`src/navigation/flow-mount-surface.mjs`。

- observed profile revision 为10，声明 `native-flow-seam-v1`、有限 rootSelectors/shellSelectors。capture 只能接受明确 seam root/原 readingViewport；legacy 只认原直接 MAIN/header/reading/composer 重建合同，不能寻找任意 LCA。
- 已存在 `display:contents` 的原生走廊无需额外修改；只有 profile明确声明的壳可以临时失去布局盒。home composer band 由已证明锚点的直接结构和原生 grid/contents关系限定，不新增模糊全局class匹配。
- 额外原生区域视为不由扩展管理内部内容的区域。保留根的父链、外部边界、相对顺序及真实控件保护；允许内部文本、装饰、普通子节点、按钮替换和自然高度变化。旧原生动作 handle 不转移给新节点。
- 区域整块 hide/show、同父新根替换、flowOrder改变，只在释放增强布局后重新证明；root/reading/composer/header/所有实际补丁目标及父链必须仍满足合同。只移除自有 row marker，保留外来 marker；在关闭态原子替换 plan/CSS，重新观察当前区域。主锚点不变时保留 iframe、JOIN、用户位置。
- 移除未知原生子树的每帧递归 paint白名单和25ms机器速度门槛。保留有限关键锚点和已登记原生控件的真实 rect/hit检查：CSSOM规则可无 Mutation/Resize事件地移动按钮，不能只靠 MO/RO 声称覆盖。
- `isNativeReadingCurrent` 是独立、严格的当前route/原始reading/新鲜adapter来源校验；缺失 callback 拒绝。`withNativeReading` 前后都校验。布局允许内部变化不产生新读取权限。
- rollback 使用独立 `isNativeReadingIdentityCurrent`：原节点、父链、URL及未被用户改写的滚动位置。撤权或native layer出现时仍可清理恢复；不得让 cleanup 依赖仍有效的数据 grant。
- 关闭事件处理忽略“迟到 toggle为closed，但当前exit已open”的旧通知；真实 beforetoggle/用户阅读意图仍生效。主动返回原生后DOM变化不得自行抢回工作区。

### 3.2 原生 root 与 frame 生命周期

涉及：`src/host/surface-controller.mjs`。

- document-flow 的旧workspace frame随同URL原生root被拆除时，立即撤旧mount/grant；保留独立document producer及用户展示意图。
- 必须得到较新的regionEpoch和当前完整native proof，才创建新frame并完成原 HOST_UI_MOUNT / HOST_UI_CONFIRM / VAIWL_UI_JOIN / HOST_UI_JOIN 流程。
- 单独移除owned sibling且原生拓扑没变时进入等待，不能无限重插。connected frame的srcdoc或contentWindow被换仍是终止性拒绝。
- sidebar的局部失败仍只退该role；不能因主题侧栏暂不可用而撤主区数据，也不能将产品连续侧栏缺失包装为最终验收通过。

### 3.3 Worker 重复恢复与熔断

涉及：`src/host/content-session.mjs`、`src/host/surface-controller.mjs`、`src/host/local-status.mjs`。

- 只有经双通道认证且authorized的workspace JOIN，才能通过私有 `bridge.workspaceEstablished({binding,mountId})` 建立新的producer恢复资格。公开页面事件/BOOT/VIEW不能调用或替代它。
- transport故障按已建立producer区分；renderer/read故障仍保留原独立一次上限。
- 同一文档RAM内滚动60秒最多3次自动transport恢复，成功JOIN不清跨代预算；第4次退到现有context wait，不新增重试timer。
- 过窗后的真实contextReady，或显式start，只能重新验证；不续长原12小时确认、不复用旧grant。stop/撤权/换scope/新document阻止旧恢复。
- 固定诊断 `surface-recovery-rate-limited`、`surface-recovery-clock-invalid`；时钟非有限或回退必须显式重新开始，不能放行。

### 3.4 F-06 空成员提示

涉及：`src/navigation/navigation.mjs`、`styles.mjs`、`tests/navigation/visible-actions.test.mjs`。

已知Project的 memberCount为0、基础及有效页均为空、offset=0/无more/没有当前成员正向证据时显示“尚未发现可显示的成员”。分页/时间过滤/折叠/管理去重造成的空列表不能误报。保留现实现，不重新写组件。

## 4. 状态与消息边界：实施时不得重新耦合

| 所有者 | 负责的事实 | 不得从中推导的事实 |
|---|---|---|
| adapter / 版本化profile | 当前原生锚点、seam、可证导航来源、原生动作目标 | 服务器账户认证、iframe权限 |
| flow surface | 自有CSS/marker/节点、展示或暂让、有限布局重新证明、可逆滚动恢复 | 数据绑定、账户改变、用户必须重新确认 |
| content-session | document/producer、用户意图、有限transport恢复、明确撤权 | 旧frame可以复用、刷新后继续私人grant |
| surface-controller / UI owner | 当前mount、frame window/document、role、有效grant和VIEW | 因DOM存在而自动有权读取 |
| navigation / view CAS | 主题、段、容量、展开、主区scroll及native-nav scroll | 原生历史状态、聊天发送成功、服务器最近活动 |
| 原生ChatGPT | 输入、模型、附件、工具、草稿、真实聊天/Project管理 | VAIWL可以复制或重新实现这些能力 |

必须保留现有入口链：content bootstrap → content-entry → createHostContentSession → createChatGPTAdapter → createFlowMountSurface；正式frame client → createNavigation。不得新增第三套renderer、缓存、认证总线或“临时主工作区”替代正式包。

主区 `desiredMode`（用户要看什么）、实际 `mode`/geometry暂停（当前能否显示）、frame授权、数据scope是不同维度。原生弹层或几何暂让不等于用户退出；frame损坏不等于服务器换号；真实撤权也不能只藏DOM而保留可用旧grant。

## 5. 剩余实施顺序：有限任务，不开放重选架构

### 阶段一：继承候选，先复核决定性反例

先运行下面的当前生产相关验证。若失败，只调对应模块；不要先跑全部长矩阵。

```bash
node tests/host/content-foreground-document-recovery.test.mjs
node tests/host/content-region-recovery.test.mjs
node tests/host/content-session-recovery.test.mjs
node tests/host/content-session-start-recovery.test.mjs
node tests/host/content-renewal-context-recovery.test.mjs
node tests/host/surface-controller.test.mjs
node tests/host/local-status.test.mjs
node tests/navigation/visible-actions.test.mjs
node tests/host/navigation-frame-calibration-entry.test.mjs
node tests/host/observed-profile.test.mjs

node tests/host/document-flow-boundary-browser.mjs /tmp/vaiwl-boundary.json
node tests/host/document-flow-boundary-mv3.mjs /tmp/vaiwl-boundary-mv3.json
VAIWL_PROBE_OUTPUT=/tmp/vaiwl-terminal.json node tests/host/terminal-delivery-mv3.mjs all
node tests/host/browser-local-mv3.mjs --flow-only
```

浏览器命令使用明确的 `FREE_CHROME_EXECUTABLE` 和隔离Profile；按原仓库工具锁安装依赖，记实际版本。新终局runner默认一包一origin、每案例独立Profile，不读用户浏览器。

本轮已跑：上述10个Node文件共377项通过；20个布局机制通过；6类原生区域变化保持同frame/JOIN=1；终局5案例同包通过；完整flow旅程通过。不要把重复运行这些相同用例相加为更多覆盖。历史红反例及初版无限恢复反例必须保留。

成功条件：真实workspace可见、有大小、可命中；root变更用新frame；普通区域变化保留frame；两次Worker实际终止后恢复personal；新document先锁旧资料；真正disable/uninstall后原生操作和草稿正常。不得只断言DOM/VIEW存在。

### 阶段二：一次性修正当前适用测试和 CI 门

本候选**已经完成** `tests/host/document-flow-browser.mjs` 的当前合同迁移，原完整runner在统一候选exit 0。不要再做一遍，也不要恢复旧paint属性禁令。迁移保留实际文字溢出、fixed控件覆盖、未知seam、原生first pointerup/click、modal/Popover、scroll rollback、用户主动退出、撤权、style/frame防篡改；把普通shadow、0.2px空子节点、内部按钮替换等改成正常变化正例。少量测试等待从setTimeout(0)改为两个rAF，匹配合并测量，没有延长产品timeout。

仍未迁移的入口必须逐个处理，不能误称所有旧测试已清完。

逐项完成以下尚未关闭的明确事项：

1. **UI10 LEGACY/MODERN/PARTIAL + populated-native**：先在扩展关闭态证明fixture自身在目标宽度下原生输入、模型、附件控件位于视口且可命中。已复现的MODERN 420px有固定260px NAV，原生控件已越界；给匿名fixture正确的响应式折叠/流布局，再保留同一正式包的可见/命中/焦点断言。不能删保护、只加timeout或悄悄将原正例跳过。真实产品首发窗口支持应写明确范围；如要缩小已批准范围须显式产品决定。
2. **snippets-package-mv3-browser**：迁移旧“双popover数量=2”前置。主区由实际flow workspace+正式renderer判就绪；片段业务确实依赖sidebar，必须提供符合 `nativeSidebarComposition` 的有界NAV分区并独立验证sidebar。保留原保存、搜索、定位、hash拒绝、删除和草稿保护业务；不能只改成>=1后跳过sidebar。
3. **observed-profile-browser / frame-shell-layout及其他旧backend**：按后端标注历史，不作为现行B唯一产品门。historyMasked=true的旧整NAV遮罩与现权威冲突；把原生保全、唯一返回、来源和真实点击等仍有效约束迁到当前flow。不能删除旧证据或恢复whole-NAV mask。
4. **SYS05 instrumented open-search**：只复现当前诊断支路的同一前置、工作量/observer和动作顺序，记录first failing phase、frame/grant/可见性；正式未插桩narrow stream成功不覆盖该失败，诊断超时也不证明IDB整体坏。不延生产超时；若instrumentation自己改变调度，应修观察器并明确与产品测试分账。它是否阻塞个人候选取决于是否影响当前批准的Browser-Local必需路径；不能把历史严格ACK诊断重新设为个人总门，也不能未经模块边界证据就把共享renderer问题标不适用。
5. **昂贵数据旅程**：将同viewport小库存

comments.body:
## 独立宿主架构裁决：选择 B，更换展示与布局整合层，保留现有 VAIWL 核心

复核基线及发布前 HEAD：**`8545f5e4d96b7843d7b6503d36f9bf6f8ebb7516`**。PR16 仍为 open / Draft / unmerged。

本次仅在独立临时副本和专用 Chrome for Testing profile 中实施实验，没有向正式分支提交、推送、改写代码，也没有操作用户日常 Chrome。Codex 继续是唯一正式 writer。此评论是独立技术裁决，不另建 PR 或第二套产品开发计划。

**裁决：B。两个 extension-origin iframe 可以继续保留；常驻工作区与主题侧栏应成为原生文档布局的成员。应替换的是承载 payload 的双 manual-popover/fixed 浮层、空 slot 与远端 frame 拼接、以及滚走原生输入以腾出工作区的合同。**

本轮取得了实际 Chrome/MV3 的纵向运行结果；**没有取得真实 ChatGPT 产品验收，不能将实验 PASS 写成 v2.7 已交付。**

### 1. 当前问题的技术根因

1. **展示坐标系选错了。** [`mount-surface.mjs`](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/8545f5e4d96b7843d7b6503d36f9bf6f8ebb7516/src/navigation/mount-surface.mjs) 将实际 iframe 放在 body 下的 fixed manual-popover section 中；原生 sidebar 内主要是占位，另行计算浮层位置、剪裁、wheel 与焦点转发。Chrome 的 [top layer 在正常文档流之外](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/what-is-the-top-layer)，不会因 renderer 内部像 v2.7 就成为 ChatGPT main 的布局成员。
2. **最新 HEAD 不是始终“卡片太窄”。** 本轮未修改的 8545 基线已经呈现宽主区及自然卡高，但原生 Project 标题、tabs、输入和工具离屏。`native-project-surface.mjs` 与 mount 的 Project flow 仍通过 composer/tabs 之后的 panel、额外 100vh 占位和 `viewport.scrollTop` 来腾屏。继续改宽度不能完成“工作区与原输入自然共存”。
3. **共存被状态机主动禁止。** mount 的 native pointer/focus 与 [`surface-controller.mjs`](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/8545f5e4d96b7843d7b6503d36f9bf6f8ebb7516/src/host/surface-controller.mjs) 的 native-input/protectedFocus 将输入活动转成 reading/隐藏 workspace。部分首页只是延迟退出。`frame-native-plans.mjs` 的 native-control 还会收起两侧，把聊天阅读与主题导航连续性耦合。
4. **旧断言没有覆盖产品合同。** 原 runner 部分用例把 Project `scrollTop>0`、canvas 足够高、draft 字符串还在、聚焦后 workspace 关闭当成成功；独立 renderer 视觉用例在批准 boardBounds 中直接渲染，绕开真实 mount。卡数、圆角、局部 overflow 不能证明整屏输入共存。本轮原始基线两次也均在既有 wheel 契约断言失败，不能继续援引“离线测试通过”作产品完成证明。

根因包含具体代码错误，但主因是宿主展示合同与产品目标不一致；不应继续把这一轮定义为有限浮层修补。

### 2. 三条路线的工程比较

| 路线 | 平台、原生功能和三类页面 | 迁移、隔离及维护风险 | 结论 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A：保留 payload popover，有限修复 | Chrome 支持。原节点可保留，但 home/project/chat 仍要分别协调外部矩形、输入焦点、滚动及工具弹层 | 仍须改 mount/controller/adapter/project/composition；数据/grants 可复用，但空 slot、远端 frame、剪裁与 relay 继续存在。已经不是“有限修复” | 不选 |
| B：extension iframe 进入原生文档流 | 实际 MV3 已跑通。已识别 native 容器内由 scoped grid 分配 workspace 与原 composer；reading 撤去工作区布局；主题与原生资源同处 native NAV | 保留 renderer、Worker、schema、scope/binding/grants 和安全导航。风险集中在 topology 变化、增强态测量、长列表滚动与 React commit；可以在宿主层明确处理 | **选择** |
| C：直接 Shadow DOM renderer | 技术可行，也可进入 flow；但需迁移 extension 页面客户端和隔离模型 | [content-script isolated world](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/content-scripts) 隔离 JS 环境，不使共享 DOM 获得 extension-origin 文档边界。没有证据表明这次更大迁移比保留 iframe 更好 | 不选 |
| C：Side Panel / 独立扩展页 | [Side Panel](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/sidePanel) 是真实可用浏览器界面；原生 ChatGPT 可继续运行 | 无法在同一个 ChatGPT main 内与同一个 composer 形成批准 v2.7 排版；需要跨面板或跨页工作 | 不作为获批体验的替代 |

本轮使用 Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.47。实验依赖的 CSS `interactivity: inert` 可查 [Chrome 135 发布说明](https://developer.chrome.com/release-notes/135)；不能用现有 manifest 最低版本直接代替能力验证。正式 backend 必须 feature-detect，不支持时保留原生页面，或明确提升最低支持版本。

### 3. 实际完成的最小纵向验证

**使用原正式 MV3 打包器、内容脚本、extension iframe、renderer、Worker、本地数据会话与原 browser runner。** 新 backend 仅在 `browserLocal + loopback + offlineDocumentFlow` 实验开关开启。没有制作另一份静态产品 mockup 来冒充正式 renderer。

宿主为仓库现有匿名结构重建，含 95 行匿名 sidebar 结构。来源文件 [`observed-host-baseline.json`](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/8545f5e4d96b7843d7b6503d36f9bf6f8ebb7516/tests/host/fixtures/observed-host-baseline.json) 明确 `rawDOMCapture:false`；几何不是完整实时 DOM 测量。真实五张用户截图只有 `free-c1-c5-product-integration-20261026.json#/realProductScreenshots20261027` 的文字 receipt，原始私人图片未入库。本轮没有声称重新看过这些原图。

最终交付 patch 已从精确 Git archive 应用到另一份干净副本，`git apply --check` 和 18 个修改文件逐字节校验通过，然后完整实跑：

- 最终 run：`vaiwl-browser-local-mv3-j1eWjc`；**PASS**；14 项纵向结果；8 次完整 workspace 产品 oracle；17 张整屏 PNG 全部实际审阅；browserErrors 为空。
- 1400×900 Project：workspace 约 **1019.5×640**；原 composer 约 **1019.5×52**、y=816–868；原生标题、tabs、Project tool、Attachment、Model 同屏。Project 卡片 **356×140，2 成员**。
- 1000×600 Project：workspace 约 **619.5×340**，原输入仍可见；键入后 workspace/sidebar 不关闭。
- 首页：workspace 约 **1100×762**，原 composer 约 **1100×70**；普通聊天投影、输入聚焦同屏。textarea 默认外观来自 fixture，不是 ChatGPT 视觉验收。
- 原生工具在原节点上真实点击一次，dialog 出现时增强让出，关闭后恢复；Project 成员走现有安全导航进入同文档原生聊天，主题折叠选择保留，能够返回正式 renderer。
- 原生 NAV 的真实 mouse wheel 产生 scrollTop=180，实际 sidebar iframe 随其移动；没有 WheelEvent 模拟或 relay。这只覆盖短主题列表。
- 页面脚本禁用后真实鼠标操作 `popovertarget` 退出；实际 `chrome.management.setEnabled(false)` 和 CDP uninstall 后，自有节点清除、原生几何恢复。没有把“模拟关闭按钮”当作停用/卸载。
- 插入一个没有文本但有 aria-label 的新原生按钮后，增强布局撤回，原控件仍可命中；不将空文字控件误当无意义占位。

节点证据覆盖原 composer/editor/必要按钮、父链、原生子节点顺序、inline style/class、draft/selection 和命中；MutationObserver 检查原生移除。另用 CDP 保留监听函数 RemoteObject 做身份相等比较：输入流程 5 targets/3 listeners，工具流程 5 targets/4 listeners 均通过；没有替换 addEventListener。此证据不排除两次采样间同函数 remove/re-add，也不代表完整 React 合成事件已验证。宿主自己换页重建结构后采新 baseline，不要求跨原生生命周期同一个 textarea。

聊天 fixture 的 native main 固定为 **780×700**，返回 workspace 约 **740×534**，报告明确 `fullViewportCoverage:false`。只证明其原容器内集成，不能宣称完整真实聊天满屏验收。

### 4. 实验中暴露的返回入口问题与设计边界

干净 replay 曾在进入聊天后等待旧页头返回入口超时。该失败、其他开发反例与原基线均保留；没有延长 50ms 扫描预算或删掉失败重跑求绿。

最终实验通过临时 sidebar footer 四格，沿既有 `onPresentationRequest → HOST_UI_PRESENT → HOST_PRESENT_SURFACE` 证明返回和角色连续性；exact frame/origin/window、有效 grants、单调 ready revision、NAV 内真实可见与命中均受检查。辅助面板占用 footer 时恢复旧 host 入口，关闭后去重，均实际执行。

**该 footer 位置不符合批准设计，明确禁止迁入正式产品。** 批准 [`INTERACTION_SPEC.md` 第 31、71 行](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/blob/8545f5e4d96b7843d7b6503d36f9bf6f8ebb7516/design/approved/v2.7/VAIWL_v2.7/docs/INTERACTION_SPEC.md) 要求阅读区左上唯一无字入口，侧栏/折叠轨不重复。正式实现保留此位置及既有可信 click、键盘焦点语义，由宿主 layout plan 给出与当前 header/reading/composer 及 layout revision 绑定的外侧安全返回槽；`ensureReturn()` 消费已验证槽，避免一次呈现内反复全页扫描同一正文。相关结构、scroll/resize、原生层或绘制边界变化须失效重验，不缓存永久许可。实验 footer/readiness 在正式迁移时删除。

**获批位置的新 slot 实现未在本轮运行；不能拿 footer PASS 冒充该项完成。**

### 5. 具体模块与复用方式

| 模块 / 函数 | Codex 的明确变更 |
| --- | --- |
| `navigation/mount-surface.mjs` → 新 `navigation/flow-mount-surface.mjs` | 以 flow backend 取代 payload popover 定位；去掉空 native slot 与远端 frame 分离、100vh 假占位、scrollTop 腾屏。保留 mount/show/reading/suspend/retire/dispose API |
| 新 `host/document-flow-layout.mjs` | home/project/conversation 三种 topology plan；原节点与父链、精确自有对象、未知分支撤回；scoped grid 只作用于已识别容器。Project 四行：标题、tabs、workspace、自然 composer；home/chat 为 workspace＋composer，保留 native 外部边界 |
| `surface-controller.mjs` | 原生输入在有效增强态布局内允许共存；conversation 阅读只收起 workspace；正式返回保持批准位置；撤权、expiry、idle、rebind、独立 role 生命周期保留 |
| `chatgpt-adapter.mjs` | 拆分结构身份、native baseline 和 active geometry；不能把实验 `withNativeLayout()` 原样作正式证明 |
| `native-surface-boundary.mjs` / `native-return-gap.mjs` | 仅精确排除闭包持有的自有 section；不靠可伪造 data 属性放宽。原生子节点计数不应把新自有 section 算成未知 native child |
| `native-project-surface.mjs` / `native-sidebar-composition.mjs` | 继续复用结构、成员和插入点识别；不再要求输入之后腾出主区。真正把 sidebar iframe 插进 NAV，保留原生 Project/近期节点与相对次序 |
| `content-session.mjs` / `frame-native-plans.mjs` | backend 选择与 preserveSidebar 呈现意图接线；保留已有原生导航计划和单次 dispatch，不强制所有点击同标签页，不放宽草稿风险 |
| `navigation.mjs` / `styles.mjs` | 正式卡片、普通聊天、主题 renderer 继续使用；卡宽 356px 上限和自然高度。仅增 flow 布局适配，不重做产品 UI |
| `free-frame-client.mjs` / `frame-shell.css` | 移除 flow 的旧 wheel/focus 坐标 relay，完成下述单滚动源与持久化解释；正式不保留实验 footer 返回 |
| MV3 entry/build/package | 当前 patch 只允许 loopback 实验开关；正式切换由 Codex 处理能力检查。无新增网站权限、无放松 CSP、无新数据库 |

**保留：** 当前实体数据库、投影语义、renderer、Worker、scope/binding/UiGrant、导航风险与单次点击、恢复 CAS/版本体系。几何与 ready 不产生数据授权；ChatGPT 原生 Project 管理继续用原节点。跨文档主题来自已有验证的 scope/引用/持久化，不根据 route 猜造归属。

**Popover 可保留为零尺寸、无私有 payload 的 CSS 退出状态开关；iframe 和工作区不再在 top layer。** 实际停用/卸载已观察，不扩展为任意进程硬终止的自动清理保证。

### 6. 正式迁移中必须一并收敛的合同

**增强态证明：** 实验 `withNativeLayout(read)` 会同步停用 workspace CSS，读取旧 adapter 的原生 baseline，再恢复。外部 oracle 检查了真实展示态，因而足以验证路线；但这个桥接不应发布。正式拆为：激活前/真实撤回后的 `captureNativeBaseline()`；不含旧几何假设的 `isSameNativeRegions()`；真正当前展示态的 `surface.validateActiveLayout(handle)`。后者检查主区剩余轨道、composer/必要工具可见可命中、标题/tabs 保留、不重叠、native modal 优先。输入共存豁免必须受该证明和当前授权约束，禁止隐藏后测量冒充 live geometry。

**连续侧栏：** 正式确定 **native NAV 为唯一滚动所有者**。当前实验 `.themes` 已 overflow:visible，但 `queueSidebarSize()` 尚有 560/1024 截断，frame-shell 仍 overflow:auto；长列表可能产生双滚动。旧 locateCurrent/rememberSidebarScroll/applyRestoredSidebarScroll/emitView 仍按 `.themes.scrollTop`，必须一起迁移。frame 高度取当前有界投影窗口或辅助面板真实固有高度；用现有分页/窗口容量控制内容规模，不设第二个内部滚动口。当前位置通过已授权坐标提示换算到 NAV，展示持久化明确 owner/窗口/锚点版本，旧 themes 像素值不得直接当 NAV 值。此处改变 presentation payload 解释，不重建实体数据库。

**宿主生命周期：** React 删除自有 sibling 或替换原生插入点时，撤回对应 role、清旧 lease、新结构通过后重新加入；不循环强插旧 parent，不 reparent native。真实 React、IME、上传/模型/语音/Canvas、完整键盘返回仍未验证，不能以 fixture 工具按钮替代。

### 7. 集中实施次序与“完成”判据

在现有 PR16 内依次完成同一条工程链：

1. flow backend＋结构/baseline/active geometry 三类证明，删除滚走 composer 的路径。
2. 输入共存、原生阅读、批准阅读区左上单一返回、工具优先与 role 撤回；保留 grants 和导航保护。
3. NAV 单滚动源、当前项定位和展示状态迁移；保留数据、主题和恢复来源。
4. 冻结一个 build，从未注入的原生 baseline 开始审阅整屏与节点身份，再用获授权的隔离真实宿主环境执行产品门槛。

完成要求是同一个 build 在 home/Project/chat、宽窄短视口下形成完整主区；输入与必要工具真实可用且不因聚焦退出；卡片自然高；长主题与原生资源层级连续；聊天阅读/返回保持主题及位置；弹层、宿主 rerender、退出、禁用/卸载均不复制、删除、重绑原生控件或留下遮罩。renderer 局部截图和测试数量不再作为产品完成依据。

**当前状态：B 的隔离工程路线已得到可运行证据；完整 v2.7 产品未批准。** 缺少的实时条件是独立可用的已登录 ChatGPT 测试会话及其真实布局/事件观测。本轮未要求用户重新安装、截图、采集 DOM 或参与测试，也不以这些缺失为借口退回继续修补 payload 浮层。

planDocument.content:
# Local integrated candidate: recovery + resource transactions

## Scope and immutable provenance

This is a **default-off source integration and verification candidate**. Draft
source publication is not production migration, activation, or release acceptance.
The older v1 mechanism documents remain historical contracts; the current v2
semantics and validation limits are recorded in
[durable attempts v2](workspace-rows-durable-attempts-v2-contract.md).

Base R1p: `c8719d17ee748e830d27881a4e96e5c96460a4c7`.
The resource chain is imported in order with `cherry-pick -x`:

1. `3d12ae12d8f22ca2d9cb9a32fb1a92705b70f62e` — eight independent files;
2. `6a1c47a` — four original-public-RPC integration files;
3. `514ab95` — retain original 8 MiB negative / fresh 16 MiB positive cases;
4. `12fa444ff66acd370afe350ff61419569665dac3` — representation inventory/peaks.

The original integration imported twelve resource files. The later durable-v2
candidate intentionally changed five existing runtime/client files and added a
versioned SQL fixture. Those evolutions are **not** a blanket exception:
`tests/fixtures/workspace-rows-history/composition.json` records original and
accepted SHA-256 values, exact paths, and the reason for each change. The static
source contract rejects any further change until its source contract is reviewed.
The reproducibility-only runner/docs edits are listed separately from algorithms.

All original SQL inputs remain byte-identical. The static contract also preserves
the complete original harness normalization and no-re-admission assertions. Its
provenance SHA values do not require unpublished Git objects to execute. Historical
sources use [independently hashed source closures](workspace-rows-reproducible-validation.md),
not a copy of the current producer/reader. None of this establishes runtime PASS:
clean-checkout runtime, database, HTTP, and independent pair gates are **NOT_RUN**
until explicitly executed on the final frozen candidate.

## Distinct tests; never combine their PASS labels

| Gate | Actual scope | Does not establish |
|---|---|---|
| `focused`, `tsc`, `unit`, `build` | Exact merged source; build includes frontend and actual API/scoped bundles | Hosted deployment or unchanged historical failures |
| `resource-pg` | Original standalone normalized adapter's 21 native groups | RPC reclaim or compatibility of that adapter with RPC peak columns |
| `resource-rpc` | Original 37 baseline + 13 resource groups through actual API/scoped factories | Three saved modes with resources ON |
| `resource-rpc-audit`, `resource-rpc-pages` | Original complete audit/adversarial suites, then original resource proof | Resources ON during the preceding audit suite |
| `resource-recovery-integrated` | Resource ON × API/scoped × inline/fragments/pages × forward/original Undo; cold integrated recovery and replay | Historical-103 provenance or R0p execution |
| `resource-recovery-r0p` | Same fresh matrix, actual independently bundled fixed R0p recovery | Hosted fallback, minutes-long recovery, or every disconnect boundary |
| `pair` | New full 81-case independent pair, fixed R0p / integrated B / real historical103 producer | Resources ON, product deadline acceptance, or repair of old pair failures |
| `install` | Two resource SQL files atomic install/late-failure rollback, public metadata/ACL/definition and lock order checks on fresh fixture | Full static production migration or existing inventory enrollment |
| `narrow-reader-only` | Original `9288be3` reader-only compatibility regression | Complete writer/large-audit fallback; full fallback is `a8c13da` |
| `matrix`, `guard-equivalence`, `equivalence`, `finalizer-plan`, `oldlarge`, `oldv3` | Retained original native regression scopes | Production load/physical capacity/hosted proof |

### Resource ON joint recovery contract

`workspace-rows-integrated-resource-recovery-native.mjs` retains the original
baseline assertions and calls a new independent proof instead of replacing any
original resource test. The original resource runner remains a separate gate.
The new harness compiles the actual original API/scoped worker from the local
integrated tree and the fixed full R0p tree
`a8c13dade102691b6562170a4d3d55d3ef724109`; no adapter or grant mock is injected.

Each target gets a **fresh database**. Each API/scoped family exercises the three
saved modes, first interrupted after original durable admission and then after
the original protected Undo metadata append. New admission is explicitly stopped
on recovery. The proof checks one initial admit, no replacement admit, the full
original encoded row/binding/authority/absolute deadline, manifest and actual
stored protocol, exact V5 receipt/projection/compensation, revision/CAS, held
capacity, per-representation original-table inventory, owner/global totals,
original audit retention, and actual consumer receipt/replay output.

Inline scoped data uses the original legal compact-ID 2,050-action fixture;
fragment/page scoped data retains original long IDs. The prepared-intent decoder
uses the existing 8 MiB decoded bound. Positive reservations are explicitly
**16 MiB before admission**, owner 32 MiB and global 264 MiB, exactly the prior
resource proof's synthetic policy; twelve held admissions total 192 MiB. No
existing admission is enlarged. The original 8 MiB capacity refusal is still a
mandatory negative case in `resource-rpc`, not weakened or relabeled.

RPC reclaim remains **unsupported**. Its historical peak constraints are not
maintained by the independently tested `PgResourceReservations` wrapper, and
release would lower held below historical peaks. Never connect that wrapper to
this RPC schema or transfer its standalone reclaim PASS to the RPC path.

## Atomic install and read-before-write order

The installation rehearsal first creates the original synthetic baseline, then
installs the two unchanged resource files under **one transaction**. An observer
must see only original function preimages until commit. A deliberate late SQL
error rolls back both the sidecar schema and all patched functions. A separate
successful transaction must keep original public RPCs, owners, ACL, invoker
status and search paths, with no seeded policy/enrollment. Structural checks
retain original grant → global → owner → reservation → head/stage ordering on
intent reads/admission and resource observation before history head access.
Observed two-session race tests remain separate dynamic evidence.

**This still uses fixture-only dynamic catalog patching.** It is not a static
production package, and does not validate preStageA → full activation. A
production package requires exact private preimages, full dependency/owner/ACL
transport, static reviewed INVOKER definitions, original legacy reader fences,
existing inventory migration, privileged acceptance, rollback/hosting and
specific authority. None is inferred from this rehearsal. Do not commit private
catalog values or credentials to this source or synthetic fixture.

## Retained failure and product gates

* R1p's two original 5,000 ms focused failures remain unattributed even though
  its separate full unit suite passed. A single diagnostic non-reproduction is
  not a fix.
* The old full page-ready pair has 55 PASS and original wrapper-deadline failure
  at case 56; a separate tail has 25 PASS. **55 + 25 is not 81 PASS.** Its first
  run also retains 14 PASS then deadline failure. New integrated results cannot
  retroactively turn any old failed run green.
* The earlier v1 baseline persisted a 10-second admitted-intent lifetime. That
  historical protocol remains unchanged for old encoded bytes. The current
  [v2 contract](workspace-rows-durable-attempts-v2-contract.md) separates immutable
  intent lifetime from each database-fenced attempt's unchanged maximum ten
  seconds. Real one-minute recovery and grouped safety checks passed on the
  runtime source before source-only packaging. This does not turn old failures
  green or establish the complete final packaged native/pair matrix as passed.
  Mixed-load readability/deadline failures remain open; no budget was enlarged.
* Original descriptor statement timeout and narrow admitted-deadline failure
  remain; no retry-until-pass, larger timeout or instrumentation attribution.
* Complete-history 32 MiB, core-compensation 1 MiB, incompressible atomic-intent,
  2 MiB response, 65,536-byte fragment and indexed-identifier limits remain.
* FS spool/reaper/process death, reclaim/retention/fairness, physical
  heap/TOAST/index/WAL/RSS, global throughput, regional RTT and production load
  remain open. Logical counters are not physical capacity.
* Production SQL/ACL, credentials, providers, resource/budget policy, merge,
  deployment and hosted-pair acceptance remain separate gates. Draft source
  publication and existing synthetic CI do not authorize production changes.

## Frozen execution

No heavy tests run during source packaging. Obtain an exclusive local test window,
install the two committed lockfile dependency sets in a clean checkout, and provide
verified PostgreSQL/PostgREST binaries as described in
[reproducible validation](workspace-rows-reproducible-validation.md).

```bash
TA_INTEGRATED_VALIDATION_WINDOW=authorized-by-parent \
TA_INTEGRATED_SOURCE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
TA_POSTGRES_BIN_DIR=/absolute/path/to/postgresql-17/bin \
TA_POSTGREST_BIN=/absolute/path/to/verified/postgrest \
bash scripts/validation/run-workspace-rows-integration-gate.sh <gate> <unique-run>
```

The runner sanitizes inherited product/test selectors, uses the shared flock,
creates a fresh owned local cluster per gate, records exit codes, refuses overwrite
or cluster takeover, verifies tracked source before/after, and checks cleanup.
Its source manifest is freshly derived from the exact clean checkout, not a
private evidence directory. The default output is ignored `.ta-validation/runs/`;
`TA_INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE_DIR` may select another absolute output directory.
The build-only generated release identity is captured and restored to its exact
prebuild tracked contents. No workflow or automatic CI policy is changed here.
